column1: # Every upstream file the build tools read (traced from a full build): source, path, SHA-1, size in bytes.
# pokefirered and pokeemerald-expansion are paths in those repos at the pinned commits; minecraft is a path under
# vendor/minecraft. setup.sh checks out the expansion paths sparsely and verifies every hash; the sounds are checked
# against asset index 19 by tools/fetch_minecraft.py instead (tools/minecraft-sounds.txt).
